preregistered.H1_pooled_calibration: The shipped robust_z static threshold switches to pooled (fit + calibration normal points) calibration iff, on 'weekend_t3' over seeds 500-509, mean event-F1(pooled - quantile) > 0 with pooled better on >= 7 of 10 seeds, AND on Gaussian 'weekend' mean event-F1(pooled - quantile) >= -0.01, AND pooled's mean realised false-alarm rate on normal test points of 'weekend_t3' is <= 0.0075 (1.5x the 0.5% budget). Otherwise it ships OFF.
preregistered.H2_guardrail: Under the rule H1 picks, robust_z mean F1 on 'weekend_t3' >= mean F1 on 'weekend' - 0.10 (slice 6's guardrail). Reported; a failure ships nothing.
preregistered.expectation: Written before the run: H1 fails on the FAR cap, because in-sample fit-window scores are tighter than held-out ones and pull the pooled threshold down.
preregistered.reported_not_decided: weekend_t5 and the two CUSUMs; thresholds and realised FARs for both rules.
